description: General structure for a one-page investor teaser generated from a pitch deck. Contains structure and field rules only; no company data.

page.column_balancing: Sections kept whole, assigned to columns in reading order at the split that best balances column heights.
page.overflow_policy: Never clip, truncate, or spill to a second page. If content does not fit at the minimum body size, refuse export and request edits.

colors.primary: Brand colour when reliably identified (theme or cover), darkened to at least 5:1 contrast on white

fields.label: Website
fields.placement: right of name; own line below tagline if the name is too long

logo.rule: Only when available and cleared for reuse; chosen or uploaded by the user.

sections.purpose: the problem and high-level market statistics
content: Who is affected and at what scale
Cost or impact of the problem
What the product or technology is
How it works at a high level
Validation status (stated as in the deck)

sections.format: one bullet per product/asset: Name (indication/use): stage
one bullet per figure with a bold TAM / SAM / SOM label

content: Commercial traction (actual vs prospective kept distinct)

sections.format: one bullet per person: **Name**, Title - credentials

sections.purpose: the funding ask and use of funds
content: Runway or milestones the round funds
sections.format: tinted box with primary-colour left rule; funding ask bold

footer.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Does not constitute an offer to sell securities.
footer.disclaimer_style: centered, italic, muted, above a thin rule

ten_capital_footer.pattern: [Document Title]   [PAGE#]   Compiled on [DATE] by TEN Capital Network   [TEN Capital Logo]

item_fields.description: Concise teaser wording; facts only from cited pages
One of the section keys above
general | tam | sam | som | funding_ask | use_of_funds | committed_capital | team_member
List of {page, quote, verified}; shown in review only, never in the PDF
Whether the item appears in the export

review_rules.missing_information: Shown in review as 'Not found in the deck'; the section or field is omitted from the PDF.
